scenarios.scenario: Introducing oneself
scenarios.context: One person introduces themselves to another.

speakerA.en: Hello! What's your name?
I'm Tom. Nice to meet you.
Where do you work?
That's nice. I work in a bank.

speakerB.en: My name is Sara. What's your name?
Nice to meet you too, Tom.
I work at a school. I'm a teacher.
Oh, that's interesting!

scenarios.scenario: Introducing two people to each other
scenarios.context: A third person introduces two strangers.

speakerA.en: Sara, this is my friend Ali.
Ali works with me. He's a doctor.
Sara lives next to me, Ali.
Good! Now you are friends too.

speakerB.en: Hello, Ali. Nice to meet you.
Oh, that's great. I'm a teacher.
Yes, we are neighbors. We often talk.
Yes! Thanks for introducing us.

scenarios.scenario: Introducing family and friends
scenarios.context: A friend visits your home and meets your family.

speakerA.en: Hi! Thank you for inviting me.
Nice to meet you. You have a lovely home.
Hi, Sam. How old are you?
I like football too!

speakerB.en: Welcome! Come in. This is my mother.
Thank you. And this is my brother, Sam.
He's twelve. He likes football.
Great! Please sit down. Would you like some tea?

scenarios.scenario: Meeting a new classmate
scenarios.context: It is the first day of class and a new student arrives.

speakerA.en: Hi! Are you new here?
Nice to meet you, Nina. I'm Omar.
Yes, it's English class. Sit here, please.
Yes, she is very kind.
Don't worry. I can help you!

speakerB.en: Yes, I am. My name is Nina.
Nice to meet you, Omar. Is this your class?
Thank you. Is the teacher kind?
That's good. I'm a little nervous.
Thanks, Omar. You're very kind.

scenarios.scenario: Introducing a friend to your roommate
scenarios.context: A student introduces his friend to his roommate.

speakerA.en: Jake, this is my friend Leo.
Leo is new in town. He's a student.
I live near the park. And you?
That's nice. Are you free now?

speakerB.en: Hi, Leo. Nice to meet you.
Welcome! Where do you live?
I live here with Peter.
Yes. Let's have some tea.

scenarios.scenario: Introducing yourself at a new school
scenarios.context: A new student introduces himself to the teacher.

speakerA.en: Good morning. I'm the new student.
My name is Karim.
I'm from Egypt.
Thank you, teacher.

speakerB.en: Welcome! What's your name?
Nice to meet you, Karim. Where are you from?
That's interesting. Come in and sit here.
You're welcome.

scenarios.scenario: Meeting a friend's brother
scenarios.context: Two people meet at a friend's house.

speakerA.en: Hi! Are you Tina's brother?
Nice to meet you, David. I'm Kate.
Yes, we work together.
Really? She's very kind.

speakerB.en: Yes, I am. I'm David.
Nice to meet you, Kate. Are you Tina's friend?
That's great. She talks about you a lot.
Come in. Tina is in the kitchen.
